def verify_refs(obj):

            p=Path(obj['path'])
            if not p.is_absolute(): p=ROOT/p
            p=p.resolve()
            assert p.is_relative_to(ROOT), str(p)
            assert p.suffix not in ('.npy','.npz','.h5','.bin'), 'real payload prohibited: '+str(p)
            assert p.stat().st_size<8*2**20, str(p)
            raw=p.read_bytes(); assert sha(raw)==obj['sha256'], str(p)
            if 'bytes' in obj: assert len(raw)==obj['bytes'], str(p)
            verified[str(p)]=dict(sha256=sha(raw),bytes=len(raw))
        for value in obj.values(): verify_refs(value)
    elif isinstance(obj,list):
        for value in obj: verify_refs(value)

def replay(raw):
    d=json.loads(raw); fractions={int(k):v for k,v in d['cpu_busy_fractions'].items()}
    for key,before in d['cpu_ticks_before'].items():
        after=d['cpu_ticks_after'][key]; elapsed=max(sum(after)-sum(before),1)
        busy=1-(after[3]-before[3]+after[4]-before[4])/elapsed
        assert math.isfinite(busy) and abs(busy-fractions[int(key)])<1e-15
    tb=d['thread_ticks_before']; ta=d['thread_ticks_after']; delta=d['thread_delta_ticks']
    for key,after in ta.items():
        if key in tb and after[0]==tb[key][0]: assert delta[key]==after[1]-tb[key][1]
    reasons={}
    for cpu,value in fractions.items():
        if value>.05: reasons.setdefault(cpu,[]).append('sample_busy_fraction_gt_0.05')
    for row in d['neighbor_processes']:
        for thread in row['threads']:
            if len(thread['affinity'])<=16:
                for cpu in thread['affinity']: reasons.setdefault(cpu,[]).append('narrow_thread_affinity:'+str(thread['tid']))
            elif delta.get(str(thread['tid']),1)>0:
                reasons.setdefault(thread['cpu'],[]).append('active_wide_thread:'+str(thread['tid']))
    decisions=[dict(**t,eligible=not any(c in reasons for c in t['siblings']),excluded_siblings={str(c):reasons[c] for c in t['siblings'] if c in reasons}) for t in d['topology']]
    assert decisions==d['cpu_decisions']
    candidates=[t['cpu'] for t in decisions if t['eligible']]
    assert candidates==d['candidate_cpus']
    return dict(status=d['status'],candidate_cpus=candidates,selected_cpu=d.get('selected_cpu'),gates=d['gates'],raw_sha256=sha(raw),static_replay_only=True)

static=[]
for name in ('src/solvers/return_block_study.py','src/solvers/return_block_direction.py','src/runners/return_block_diagnostic.py','src/runners/block_direction_diagnostic.py'):
    p=ROOT/name; code=p.read_text(); st=symtable.symtable(code,name,'exec')
    defined={s.get_name() for s in st.get_symbols() if s.is_assigned() or s.is_imported() or s.is_namespace()}

                missing.append(dict(scope=scope.get_name(),scope_line=scope.get_lineno(),name=symbol.get_name()))
